story.title: Born from a gap we could no longer ignore.
paragraphs: Munay was founded in 2026 in response to a profound gap in services for underserved communities. Survivors of abuse, assault, trafficking, torture and intimate partner violence were too often left without accessible, culturally rooted care — and with few places to talk about their bodies without shame.

We built the space we wished existed: one where positive sexual education meets somatic and holistic healing, where consent is not a footnote but the foundation, and where Andean wisdom is honored rather than extracted.
The name Munay means unconditional love in Quechua. For us, that love is a practice: showing up, listening, and creating the conditions for every person to remember their own capacity to heal.

about.title: Care that is rooted, accessible and shared.
about.intro: Munay is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit founded in 2026. We accompany underserved communities through sexual education and trauma-informed somatic and holistic healing.
missionBody: Munay offers accessible services, workshops and one-day retreats for survivors of sexual abuse, assault, trafficking, torture and intimate partner violence, as well as for the communities that hold them.

We combine positive sexual education with somatic, holistic and ancestral practices so that healing is not a luxury reserved for a few. Every space is consent-led, culturally grounded and designed with the people we serve.
We do not replace clinical or legal care. We walk beside people as they access it, and we build alternatives where none exist.
visionBody: We envision a world where every person can live in a body that feels safe, speak about sexuality without shame and receive care that honors their culture, their history and their whole self.

Our vision is intersectional: healing is entangled with migration, race, gender, class, disability and the land. We work toward a future where communities are not only served but lead the creation of their own care.
We see Munay as a small part of a much larger movement: one where unconditional love becomes practical, collective and liberating.

programs.title: Healing that meets you where you are.
programs.intro: Our approach is holistic, community-centered and built for people who have been underserved by traditional care. These are the principles that shape every offering.

principles.title: Trauma-informed by design
principles.description: Consent, predictability, choice and safety are built into every session. You are never required to share more than you want.

principles.title: Culturally rooted
principles.description: We honor Andean wisdom, migration stories and the many ways people make meaning. Care should feel like home, not like a foreign language.

principles.title: Accessible and community-led
principles.description: Sliding-scale options, local partnerships and community voice shape what we offer and who can reach it.

programs.workshopsIntro: Participatory, shame-free sessions on sexual education and the themes that surround sexuality. We adapt each workshop to the age, language and lived reality of the group.
programs.individualIntro: One-to-one care for the mind, body and soul. Choose the path that feels right for you — or write to us and we will help you find it.
programs.retreatsIntro: A full day to slow down, return to the body and be held in community.
retreatsBody: Our day retreats weave gentle movement, somatic practices, shared food and quiet time in nature. They are designed for people who need rest but cannot step away for a full week.
Each retreat has a small group, clear agreements and facilitators trained in trauma-informed care. No previous experience is needed.
Dates are announced as they are confirmed. If you would like to bring a retreat to your community or organization, we would love to hear from you.

legal.metaDescription: Munay's privacy policy, terms of use and cookies.
legal.title: Small print, deep care.
legal.intro: Here we explain how we care for your data, the conditions of our programs and how cookies are used on this site.

sections.title: Privacy policy
paragraphs: Munay only collects the information you share with us through our contact and newsletter forms: name, email address, subject and message. We use it to reply to your request and, if you subscribe, to send occasional updates about our work.
We never sell, rent or share your data with third parties for commercial purposes. You can request access, correction or deletion by writing to info@munayinaction.org.

sections.title: Terms of use
paragraphs: Munay's programs are educational and holistic in nature. They do not replace medical, psychological or legal care. If you are in crisis or need urgent support, please contact local emergency services or a qualified professional.
Workshop and retreat registrations are confirmed according to the terms shared for each program. If you need to cancel, write to us and we will do our best to offer an alternative.

sections.title: Cookies
paragraphs: This site only uses technical cookies needed to remember your language and to keep navigation working. We do not use advertising or third-party tracking cookies.
You can delete cookies from your browser settings at any time. If we add analytics in the future, we will update this page and ask for your consent.
